title: spec-form-stepper-f1.md Suggested Review Order links point at wrong form_stepper.js lines (stale after the r1 fix rewrite)
evidence: Spec: '[`form_stepper.js:185`](../../server/priv/static/form_stepper.js#L185)' labelled 'First-error start step' — actual line 185 is '  // The Continue hold for the documents step (pure predicate, exported for' while '  function firstErrorIndex(sectionEls, opts) {' is at line 235. '[`form_stepper.js:221`]' labelled 'Entry point: progressive-enhancement choreography' — actual line 221 is '      el.querySelector &&' while initBrowser is at 284. '[`form_stepper.js:345`]' labelled 'markInvalid' — actual line 345 is '      seg.className = "stepper-segment";' while markInvalid is at 411. '[`form_stepper.js:406`]' labelled 'Continue: preflight hold' — actual line 406 is '        sections[i].el.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" });' while onContinue is at 473.
detail: Four of six form_stepper.js review-order deep links land on unrelated code; the r1 fix push rewrote the file and the pointers were not re-based, misdirecting any reviewer following the committed spec.
recommended_fix: Re-base the six links to current lines (initBrowser 284, findInvalidControls 80, onContinue 473, resolveAnchorTarget 172, firstErrorIndex 235, markInvalid 411) or drop line numbers in favour of function names.

title: Spec's checked-off task claims form_view_test.gleam pins the F3-SEAM substring; no such pin exists in any test
evidence: Spec line 78: '- [x] `server/test/application/form_view_test.gleam` — pin: 8 sections visible (no `hidden` on fieldsets), ids in order, details closed pristine/open prefilled, `listing_source` absent, F5 helpers present, script tag present, prep block + F3-SEAM substring intact.' detail: The task is marked done but the F3-SEAM substring assertion was never written; the boundary the spec marks byte-untouched for follow-up C (line 26) has no test guarding the seam comment, only the prep-block copy.
